title: Reject Bahia edge images that predate the relay-flood fixes
observed_failure: The edge rollback path restored sha256:0860217692710fe58b4e0060ee0b1be16dc1f2dd3465346e2cba2dc914098638, whose source predates the accepted material-change and projector dedupe fixes.
invariants: Production deployment is manually dispatched with an exact 40-character release revision.
The release revision descends from both required flood-fix commits.
The built image has an immutable sha256 ID and matching OCI source revision.
The image carries the required relay-flood safety epoch.
Rollback restores an independently admitted post-fix Bahia image, never the raw pre-deploy Bahia image.
The Bahia updater never changes the independently managed relay image.
Only the one previously live-accepted unlabeled post-fix digest may use the legacy compatibility path.
out_of_scope: Signer, key, ACL, grant, binding, or custody changes
Deploying Hive-CI changes before their worker rollout dependencies
